final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(feerate) as avg_feerate, AVG(rebrate) as avg_rebrate FROM fees WHERE orderslink IS NOT NULL GROUP BY orderslink), step2 AS (SELECT u.acctscope, AVG(s1.avg_feerate - s1.avg_rebrate) as avg_net, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM step1 s1 JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = s1.orderslink JOIN users u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink WHERE u.acctscope IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.acctscope), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_net) as overall_avg FROM step2) SELECT s2.acctscope, s2.avg_net, s2.cnt, s2.avg_net - s3.overall_avg as net_diff FROM step2 s2, step3 s3
